transcript.content: Hi, I can't send emails.
Let me help. I'm going to ask you several questions to narrow this down. First, your name?
Sarah.
Full name please.
Sarah Thompson.
Company?
Alder & Co Accountants.
Great. Now, when did this start? Be as specific as you can.
This morning around 9am.
Is it just you or the whole company?
Just me, I think.
How critical is this? What's blocked?
I need to send financial reports to a client by 2pm.
Alright, so we have a deadline. That's important. What happens when you try to send?
It stays in outbox.
Any error message?
It says Send/Receive error.
Okay. Before we dig deeper, quick check — can you access Outlook Web App in a browser?
Let me try... yes, webmail works.
That tells us it's a client-side issue. Any recent changes to your system?
I changed my Windows password yesterday.
There we go. Your Outlook cached credentials are likely out of sync. Let me update them.
Okay, how do we do that?
Go to File > Account Settings > Account Settings > select your account > Repair. It will walk you through re-entering your credentials.
Doing it now... it's asking for my password.
Enter your new password there.
Done! It says connected.
Try sending a test email.
It sent! Thank you so much.

You're welcome, Sarah. Just to summarise: the issue was your Outlook profile still had your old cached password after you changed it. Updating the credentials in the account settings fixed it. If this happens again after a password change, you can follow the same steps.
Perfect, I'll remember that.
I'm logging the ticket with full details. If you have any other issues, don't hesitate to call back.

ticket.summary: Outlook send error resolved — updated cached credentials after password change
ticket.description: User: Sarah Thompson, Alder & Co Accountants. Issue: Outlook cannot send emails, messages stuck in outbox. Scope: Single user. Impact: Cannot send financial reports to client. Urgency: Deadline 2pm today. Error: Send/Receive error. Workaround: Webmail works. Recent change: Windows password changed yesterday. Diagnosis: Outlook cached credentials out of sync after password change. Action: Updated password in Outlook Account Settings > Account > Repair. Resolution: Test email sent successfully. Next step: Follow same steps after future password changes.

expected.notes: Textbook perfect call. Everything covered including clear summary at end. Should score near 100.
